breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible plane-strain problem is switched from a mixed displacement-pressure (u-p) formulation to a displacement-only solve
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses a mixed displacement-pressure formulation ('A mixed displacement-pressure formulation will be used'), with separate displacement (second-degree Lagrange) and pressure (first-degree Lagrange) fields, and a direct saddle-point solver. This correctly resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly specified a displacement-only element, aligning with the ground truth's requirement for a mixed u-p formulation due to near-incompressibility (ν=0.49).
